svg.title: Сгибание ног на скамье с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Prone resistance-band hamstring curl ON A FLAT BENCH, side three-quarter view. Torso and both thighs supported horizontally on a flat padded bench, head at left, knees at its far right end. An elastic band clearly connects both ankle cuffs to a stationary low anchor beyond feet at right side, pulled taut in both panels. Left: shins extend behind body to right, both legs almost straight and clear of floor. Right: bend BOTH knees to lift heels toward buttocks, thighs and pelvis stay pressed to bench, band stretches diagonally from SAME fixed low right anchor to both elevated ankles. Bench must be obvious. No cables, weight plates, pulley, dumbbell, or lever. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
